# atlassian_confluence_spaces (Data Source)

Returns every Confluence Cloud space matching the configured filters. **Archived spaces are included unless `status` is used to filter them out**: with no status filter, the API returns archived spaces alongside current ones. Ordering is not exposed, so the result is a set at every cardinality, including zero or one match.

## Required OAuth scopes

When the provider authenticates as a service account, its credential must carry:

- `read:space:confluence`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_confluence_spaces" "example" {
  status = "current"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `favorited_by` (String) Account ID of a user; matches spaces that user has favorited.
- `ids` (Set of String) Space IDs to match.
- `keys` (Set of String) Space keys to match.
- `labels` (Set of String) Space labels to match.
- `not_favorited_by` (String) Account ID of a user; matches spaces that user has not favorited.
- `status` (String) Space status to match. Set this to exclude archived spaces from the result.
- `type` (String) Space type to match.

### Read-Only

- `spaces` (Attributes Set) Every space matching the configured filters. The set is empty when no space matches. Includes archived spaces unless status is used to filter them out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spaces))

<a id="nestedatt--spaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spaces`

Read-Only:

- `author_id` (String) Account ID of the user who created the space.
- `created_at` (String) Date and time the space was created, RFC 3339.
- `current_active_alias` (String) Currently active alias for the space.
- `description` (Attributes) Space description in the plain representation. Null when the space has no description. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spaces--description))
- `homepage_id` (String) ID of the space's homepage.
- `id` (String) Numeric-string ID of the space.
- `key` (String) Key of the space.
- `name` (String) Name of the space.
- `space_owner_id` (String) Account ID of the user who owns the space. Absent on some responses.
- `status` (String) Status of the space.
- `type` (String) Type of the space.

<a id="nestedatt--spaces--description"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spaces.description`

Read-Only:

- `representation` (String) Representation of value. Only plain is currently returned.
- `value` (String) Description text.
